I told Hollis in a thread in #central-team that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats.

- **Source:** Tobias posted that figure in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since changes it. Hollis is a member of that channel, so they could already see it.
- **No second source:** I found no Marrow account files in the share to check it against. I suggested Hollis confirm with Tobias before updating the account sheet.
- **Sharing:** A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so there was no problem sharing it with the account's team.

One thing to tidy up: when I logged Tobias's message on Oct 14, my wrap-up note was also posted in #central-team as its own message (ts …0125). It only repeats the seat count, so nothing was exposed, but that kind of note shouldn't go into the channel.
